hypotheses.C10: Pooled LP2 unigram LLR for three mappings, three decrypt modes, mixture weights 1, .5, .25 and best of 29 constant offsets; fixed exclusion line -10 nats.
hypotheses.C11: Within each source segment, (C[i]+sign*C[i-lag]) mod29 at lags 2..1000 and signs +-1; Pearson chi-square upper tail and Bonferroni alpha .01/1998.
hypotheses.C12: Within source segments, off-diagonal C[i-lag],C[i] transition chi-square at lags 1..1000; Wilson-Hilferty upper tail and Bonferroni alpha .01/1000.
hypotheses.C13: Pooled LP2 unigram LLR for uniform key alphabets decimal 0..9, hex 0..15, Latin A..Z 0..25 and source English Latin-letter weights, best of three decrypt modes and 29 offsets; fixed exclusion line -10 nats. Wide alphabets 60/100/256 are declared underpowered, not rejected.

interpretation_limit: These are model-conditional distribution/lag screens, not decryption searches or proof against arbitrary English text, every ciphertext autokey, or all substitution alphabets.
